_README: THIS IS A SECURITY DECLARATION, NOT CONFIGURATION.
An entry here states that a function is DELIBERATELY reachable without the gateway JWT check,
and that it does its own authentication. Adding one expands the public attack surface.
Review a diff to this file as a security decision, not a config tweak.
Modes: hmac = verifies a signature itself. platform-api-key = checks a platform key header.
orbi-api-key = checks against orbi_api_keys table (SHA-256 hash, revoked_at IS NULL).
none = intentionally public, no auth at all.
internal-worker-token = checks X-Internal-Worker-Token header against a vault secret (service-internal callers only, never exposed to integrators).

platform-api-key-or-widget-token = accepts a platform key header, OR a widget_token in the request BODY when no key header is present. The token is a pending_widget_sessions row id, minted server-to-server by or-link-mint-token; the platform and app_user_id are read off that row and can never be named by the caller. It is a short-lived bearer credential (300s default, 900s max) and is validated WITHOUT being consumed, so its replay window is the remaining TTL rather than a single request. It exists because a host app's user has no OrangeRails JWT and a browser must never hold a platform key. Same credential or-discover-wallets and or-link-complete already accept. See authenticateWidgetToken in _shared/platform-auth.ts.
CI (scripts/check-public-auth.mjs) asserts this file and config.toml agree in both directions.
